name: branding-black-monogram-profile-icons-and-store-listing
title: Black Monogram in Profile, Icons and Store
whatItIs: A three-part board: a social profile card with a metallic card cover and a black circular avatar holding the white mark, a row of three app icons including the brand's black tile beside Safari and Slack, and an app store listing.
whatItMeans: A single high-contrast mark works as avatar, icon and store icon, proving flexibility.
techniques: Same bold mark in circle and rounded-square formats
Metallic embossed card imagery as a profile cover

vocabulary.definition: The logo adapted to a circular profile picture.
Familiar app icons placed beside a new one for comparison.
A raised, pressed surface look in imagery.
